item.title: ABOUT GHOST WORLD
item.description: When Ekkehard Knörer was visiting New York City several months ago, we discussed the possibility of my writing about Bollywood for his online magazine, Jump Cut. I wanted to do something somewhat focused, concentrating on Indian films readily available on DVD. After back-and-forthing with Ekkehard for a bit, we hit on the idea of "Ghost World": An irregular English-language blog-column on Bollywood noir films, past and present. English-language because: (a) mein Deutsch ist nicht so wundervoll;
